description: Add support for the built-in Glide Data Grid search functionality to the DataEditor component. This will enable users to search through data displayed in the DataEditor using the grid's native search bar.
functional_requirements: Expose search-related props from the underlying Glide Data Grid component to the Reflex DataEditor API
Implement search functionality that works with the DataEditor's existing data structure and state management
Ensure the search feature integrates properly with other DataEditor features like sorting and filtering
Add appropriate documentation for the new search props in the DataEditor component
Maintain backward compatibility so existing DataEditor usage continues to work without changes
